280967744.description:
Natural Mineral and Crystal Specimen Lot
Quartz Geodes, Halite, and Rough Stones
5.0 lbs
This expansive collection comprises a diverse selection of natural mineral specimens, showcasing various geological formations. The lot is characterized by numerous split quartz geodes, which exhibit intricate crystalline interiors and druzy formations. Included is a specific specimen of Halite (Salt) originating from the Stratica Mine in Hutchinson, Kansas, providing geographic context to the collection. The assembly also contains crystalline clusters, rough opaque stones, and larger smooth specimens, reflecting a broad spectrum of mineralogy.
Diverse collection of over 30 mineral specimens including quartz and halite
Labeled Halite specimen from the Stratica Mine in Hutchinson, Kansas
Multiple split geodes featuring transparent to white crystalline structures
Individual specimen sizes range up to approximately 3 inches in length
Condition:
Very good condition overall with average wear consistent with natural specimens. The largest piece in the lot measures approximately 3 inches. Some specimens are in their natural rough state, while others have been split to show interiors. Labeled mine-specific samples are secured in plastic bags for preservation.
